<translate>
<!--T:1-->
DragonMineZ adds its own '''status effects'''. Some are gameplay effects you will notice: combat control, buffs, food and plant boosts, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Mark|Majin Mark]] and the Mutant. The rest are '''internal markers''' the mod uses to track transformations, charging, dashes and cooldowns.
</translate>

<translate>
== Commands == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
Admins can give or remove DMZ's three long-term character effects, [[Special:MyLanguage/Fruit of the Tree of Might|Might Fruit]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin|Majin]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mutant|Mutant]], with <code>/dmzeffect</code> (<code>-1</code> means permanent):

<!--T:4-->
* <code>/dmzeffect give &lt;mightfruit, majin or mutant&gt; &lt;seconds or -1&gt; [targets]</code>
* <code>/dmzeffect remove &lt;effect&gt; [targets]</code>
* <code>/dmzeffect clear [targets]</code>

<!--T:5-->
<code>/dmzeffect remove</code> also accepts <code>knockout</code>, which removes the K.O. effect and gets a knocked-down player back up. Besides the effects, <code>/dmzeffect clear</code> also removes the God Ritual cooldown and the Ki Transfer effects, and ends a knockdown.

<!--T:6-->
The other effects work with the vanilla <code>/effect</code> command, using their id with the <code>dragonminez:</code> prefix. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Combat control == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:8--> Effect</translate> !! <translate><!--T:9--> Id</translate> !! <translate><!--T:10--> What it does</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:11--> Stunned</translate> || <code>stun</code> || <translate><!--T:12--> You can't move or act. Applied when your '''guard is broken''' (3 seconds by default), to the loser of a beam clash or a [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Clash|strike clash]], and by some techniques (for example the Bio-Android's Vital Drain).</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:13--> Staggered</translate> || <code>stagger</code> || <translate><!--T:14--> −25% movement and attack speed. Applied for 3 seconds to an attacker whose hit you '''parry'''.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:15--> Ki Slow</translate> || <code>ki_slow</code> || <translate><!--T:16--> −90% movement speed for a moment (1.5 seconds) after being hit by a ki attack (not by small ki blasts).</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:17--> Candy</translate> || <code>candy</code> || <translate><!--T:18--> The target is turned into candy and '''can't attack''' until the effect ends. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Evasion Techniques|Candy Beam]] technique candies its target for 3 seconds; the Majin Candy beam of Majin Buu, [[Special:MyLanguage/Evil Buu|Evil Buu]] and Majuub keeps it on while the beam hits, and a while after.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:19--> K.O.</translate> || <code>knockout</code> || <translate><!--T:20--> Shown while you are '''knocked down''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Combat#Knockdowns|Combat]]), with the time left before you get back up. Milk doesn't remove it; removing it with a command gets you back up at once.</translate>
|}

== Raids == <!--T:60-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:61--> Effect</translate> !! <translate><!--T:62--> Id</translate> !! <translate><!--T:63--> What it does</translate>

<translate>
== Ki Transfer and the God Ritual == <!--T:66-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:67--> Effect</translate> !! <translate><!--T:68--> Id</translate> !! <translate><!--T:69--> What it does</translate>

| <translate><!--T:70--> Shared Ki</translate> || <code>ki_transfer_boost</code> || <translate><!--T:71--> Other players are giving you Ki with [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Transfer|Ki Transfer]]: '''+5%''' STR, SKP, DEF and PWR per giver (up to +25%). Its level is the number of givers, and it lingers for a while after they stop.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:72--> Ki Exhaustion</translate> || <code>ki_transfer_drain</code> || <translate><!--T:73--> You have been giving Ki with Ki Transfer: '''−5%''' STR, SKP, DEF and PWR for every 3 seconds of giving (up to −25%). |-
| <translate><!--T:74--> God Ritual CD</translate> || <code>god_ritual_cd</code> || <translate><!--T:75--> You can't take part in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Super Saiyan God Ritual|Super Saiyan God Ritual]]: 30 minutes after a successful ritual (for the receiver, after Super Saiyan God ends), or 30 seconds after an interrupted one.</translate>
|}

<translate>

<!--T:77-->
These two effects change your character for a long time and have their own pages.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:78--> Effect</translate> !! <translate><!--T:79--> Id</translate> !! <translate><!--T:80--> What it does</translate>

|-
| {{L|Mutant}} || <code>mutant</code> || <translate><!--T:82--> Marks you as one of the server's rare '''Mutants''', with faster TP and mastery gain and a '''rage meter''' that powers up the Legendary forms.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Internal markers == <!--T:83-->

<!--T:84-->
The mod uses these to track state and cooldowns; you normally won't interact with them directly:

<!--T:85-->
<code>transform</code>, <code>transformed</code>, <code>stack_transform</code>, <code>stack_transformed</code>, <code>kicharge</code>, <code>fly</code>, <code>fused</code>, <code>fusion_cd</code>, <code>saiyan_passive</code> (Zenkai cooldown), <code>bioandroid_passive</code> (Vital Drain cooldown), <code>bioandroid_explode_cd</code> (Self-Destruct cooldown), <code>majin_revive</code> (Revive cooldown), <code>dash_cd</code>, <code>doubledash_cd</code>, <code>teleport_cd</code>, <code>ki_blast_cd</code>, <code>poise_cd</code>.
</translate>
